declaredIntent.summary: Run the complete final verification matrix for the delivered installation and calibration wizard and record an evidence-backed user report without overstating external toolchain coverage.

preReviewWarnings: Verify every entrypoint, reuse point, safety guarantee, test result, release check, and known gap against repository evidence; do not infer external Xcode/Gradle/CocoaPods/JDK/instrumented execution.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The Summary lists the merged WI1–WI10 changes, entrypoints, core reuse points, and absence of duplicate transition/activation logic.
The Summary records local test count, Python version, quality/governance/release checks, and CI/PR evidence with pass or explicit not-run reasons.
The Summary states dry-run read-only, confirmation, blocking/recovery, localization/key parity, iOS/Android/generic fixture scope, and secret-safety evidence.
Every Known Gap is explicit, including external mobile toolchain execution not run; no ready claim hides an unresolved required item.
The final verification matrix and Work Item lifecycle checks pass before PR creation.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The implementation and documentation Work Items are individually complete, but reviewers need one final evidence-backed report that reconciles their entrypoints, reuse boundaries, safety guarantees, test/CI results, release evidence, and known gaps before the plan can proceed to cleanup.
constraints: Do not change production behavior in this reporting Work Item.
Use archived Work Item records, repository checks, PR/CI evidence, and the Capability Truth Matrix as the evidence sources.
Report external Xcode, Gradle, CocoaPods, JDK, and instrumented test execution as not run unless an independent result exists.
intent.rationale: A dedicated final verification boundary makes the completed wizard work legible to reviewers and preserves calibrated trust before plan-document cleanup and release publication.
